FN-9JWEDMM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 320
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 320 as introduced could increase: (1) receipts to the Alabama Liquefied Petroleum
Gas Board by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of fines collected, not to
exceed $1,000 per violation, for the storage or filling of petroleum within 3,000 feet of certain
public properties and (2) the administrative obligations of the board to enforce the provisions of
the bill.
This bill could also increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds
from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and
the penalties imposed.
